task.description: Validate test design for ENV-01, ENV-02, ENV-03, ENV-05. Hard gate — TEST-RUNNER cannot start until PASS.

result.summary: Test design for ENV-01, ENV-02, ENV-03, ENV-05 validated. All MUST requirements (ENV-01: 12 tests, ENV-02: 3 tests, ENV-03: 6 tests) have runnable integration test files. No error.SkipZigTest found. All primary fixture IDs are per-test UUIDs via randomUuidStr(). All tests clean up via defer blocks. All tests fail clearly on absent BPM_TEST_DB_URL. zig build exits 0. No pipeline steps needed (all ENV requirements are backend API endpoints tested at the domain layer, no sequential UI actions involved).

issues.description: env01_test.zig uses fixed slugs for some fixtures (e.g. tc-env01-04-prod, tc-env01-09-test). Primary IDs are per-test UUIDs and cleanup runs by UUID, but if a previous failed run left an orphaned row the slug unique constraint could cause a conflict on re-run. env02/03/05 correctly use UUID-as-slug. Recommend updating env01 fixed slugs to UUID-derived values.

Spec has 7 TCs (TC-ENV-03-01..07) but test file has 6 test blocks. Spec TC-ENV-03-05 (Promoted definition is DRAFT) is verified inline inside TC-ENV-03-01 via expectEqualStrings DRAFT status. Spec TC-ENV-03-07 (version increment) is implemented as test block TC-ENV-03-05. Coverage is complete; traceability numbering diverges from spec.

Spec TC-ENV-05-07 (reset atomicity) is covered indirectly via TC-ENV-05-04. The spec itself acknowledges this indirect approach. No dedicated atomicity test block exists, but the 409 active-instances guard prevents any partial truncation from being observable.
